proposal.reason: Main change is copy-engine behavior: CE memcpy and ltOki DMA rings are explicitly separated, OKI enablement is gated across ranks/system capabilities, CE stream/ring assignment is reworked, and QP queue IDs/resource lifecycle are updated to prevent mixed CE+ltOki hangs. Include symmetric because device-side symmetric CE/OKI kernels change DMA tail sizing and lane slice alignment, affecting AR/RS correctness. Include enqueue because ordinary enqueue now applies memcpy stream ring hints with capture-aware behavior, changing host-side stream/capture sequencing semantics.
